correctness.rationale: The maximal (Z/2)^4 genus-five cover of P1 branched over five distinct points has five elliptic quotient characters; its Jacobian is prime-to-7 isogenous to the product, so 7-rank and a-number add. In characteristic 7 the Legendre Hasse Deuring cubic h(t)=(t-2)(t-4)(t-6); five omitted-branch cross ratios r0=u,r1=v,r2=v/u,r3=(v-1)/(u-1),r4=u(v-1)/(v(u-1)) yield five divisors each with three smooth rational irreducible components. S5 transitivity reduces each pairwise intersection to u,v in {2,4,6} distinct (six points); at (2,4) exactly three factors vanish with three distinct tangent directions. Double-count 10 divisor pairs x6 / binom(3,2)=20 triple points, all M0,5(F7) of cardinality20; 15 components each contain four. Thus only (f7,a)=(5,0),(4,1),(2,3) and only twenty maximal-degeneration ordered points. Independent modular enumeration reproduced all 20 tests, 15 components, 10 six-element pair intersections and three-factor incidences. Computation alone does not prove completeness over closure; S5 geometry does.
